verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs explicitly claim web browsing of code files and commit history, and a community user confirms that non-contributors read source through the web UI instead of cloning. Line-by-line blame, one of the story's three elements, is not evidenced anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: documented line-by-line blame view, in-depth first-party docs on the file/history browsing UI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can browse repository files, commit history, and line-by-line blame in the web interface
